parts:
A1 English Listening Test

Sophie is an American woman living in the UK. Listen to Sophie answering questions about her last holiday. For questions 1 to 8, choose true or false.

See the full list of A1 listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: Sophie went on holiday to Britain last year.
Sophie went on holiday with her friends.
Sophie stayed in guest houses on her holiday.
Sophie’s guide book said that food from the market was safe and delicious.
Sophie got sick after buying food from a market.
Sophie was only sick for one day.
Sophie’s favourite part of the trip was taking boat trips.
